Name: [Formatting] Provide a format string for visible measures
Description: Visible measures should have a format string so they display consistently in every report.

Name: [Governance] Document visible measures with a description
Description: Every visible measure needs a business definition in its description so it can be certified and maintained.

Name: [Performance] Do not use floating point data types
Description: Floating point columns can produce rounding surprises and compress poorly. Use Decimal or Integer where possible.

Name: [Performance] Avoid bidirectional relationships
Description: Bidirectional cross-filtering can create ambiguity and slow queries. If it is required, justify it in the relationship description.

Name: [Modeling] Avoid many-to-many relationships
Description: Many-to-many relationships make grain and totals harder to reason about. Prefer a bridge table with a documented grain.

Name: [Formatting] Do not summarize visible numeric columns
Description: Numeric columns that authors should not add up (identifiers, years, codes) should have Summarize By set to None. Use explicit measures for aggregation.
Expression: (DataType = "Int64" or DataType = "Decimal" or DataType = "Double") and IsHidden = false and SummarizeBy <> "None"
